description: Call this first for every new question. Read the user's request and choose mode: "hypothesis_test" when they want to know whether a difference, effect or relationship is real / significant / caused by something, or want to test a claim; "explore" when they want to describe, summarise, visualise, estimate or plan, without testing a claim. If the request is ambiguous, ask the user before calling. Returns the steps to follow.

file.description: The data file the user named or attached to the chat (CSV, TSV, Excel or Parquet): pass its path or name, never its contents. Large files are fine.

mode.description: "explore" for describing, comparing, ranking, summarising, charting or finding patterns (most analytics questions); "hypothesis_test" when asked whether a difference or relationship is significant / real.

question.description: The user's request, in their own words.

name: start_analysis
title: Start an analysis
